title: 第265章 退休了退休了第264章 吃了华莱士全家桶拉完了
content_zh:
第265章退休了退休了！
“波~”
像是石子入水般，这颗暗金色的丹药直接融入了云阳的身体。
随即便是一股子比36D还汹涌澎湃的生命力充斥四肢百骸，结合之前与“红名怪”——夜叉一族对战得到的经验，直接让云阳突破至元婴后期。
但云阳能感受到，这颗丹药只被自己利用了点皮，emmm……皮屑吧，百分之九十九点九九的药力还在自己体内深处藏着。
唉~我不是个随便的男人，但……但它给的太多了啊~
……
在看到云阳毫发无损的从封印口中飞出，一直守着封印的龙族众妖第一反应却是茫然。
直到维持着封印开口的龙王敖青“噗通”一屁股坐在了地上。
完全没有点元婴巅峰大妖的样子。
“结，结束了？”
这话像是在问，又好像是在和自己说话。
“对，结束了。”
站在他面前穿着玄天门内门弟子服饰的云阳还是那副衣衫飘飘的模样，背着手仿佛是刚遛弯回来的老大爷似的。
语气平淡，好像并不是多大的一件事。
可不语气平淡吗？刚开完无双就像进入贤者模式似的。
“哦对了，关夜叉一族挺大的地方挺大的，这个封印大阵挺不错的，反正我的阵法造诣与之相比差要差得远，或许你可以好好利用一下。”
云阳还不忘给出建议。
“谢了。”敖青长如释重负似的舒出一口气后起身，略带歉意的说道：“抱歉让你看笑话了，实在是得知压在龙宫头上的那座大山没了，有点激动。”
“理解。”

云阳点了点头。
都这个氛围了，总不能突然来一句“咕咕嘎嘎”吧？
“那个……烈儿。”敖青将那位同样懵逼的龙宫大皇子唤来，取出一枚漆黑的令牌推到他怀里，“好了，以后龙宫就交给你了。”
“啊？啊？！”
这未免有点太突然了吧？
“交给你了。”敖青就像个，啊不，此时此刻他就是个退休老大爷，忙不迭的想把工作交给接班人似的，“要不是因为有夜叉这么个隐患在头顶压着，我特么早就不想干了，等把你弟弟安葬后，我就去寻找能治愈你妹妹的方法，把这两件事解决了，我不管是坐化，还是运气好晋升化神前往高等界域都不会留下遗憾了。”
“……”听到自己父亲的坦言，大皇子不由得沉默了一下，不过他还是有点犹豫，“可我才金丹……我的能力或许还是不太够……”
“之前你篡位篡的不是挺好的吗？哦，我没有贬低你的意思。”龙王敖青拍了拍大皇子的肩膀，“老虾和老蟹他俩忠心，也都愿意跟随你，之前做战前准备的时候，决策果断，指挥有方，除了实力以外，你已经具备了成为一名领袖的所有素质，现在夜叉这座大山已经被移除了，对龙宫的继承人的实力要求也就不那么重了，慢慢提升，在我坐化或者找到一丝晋升化神的契机之前，你肯定能步入元婴的。”
说完，敖青也不再给他的大儿子任何或反驳或谦让的机会，直接朝云阳做了个请的手势，道：“抱歉让阁下等了一会，请吧阁下，我带你去龙宫的宝库完成先前的承诺。”
看着直接离去的父亲，大皇子又看了看手中的漆黑令牌，脑中不由得浮现出自己几百年岁月的经历，像是释然般哑然失笑。
第265章退休了退休了！
摇了摇头，将漆黑令牌收了起来，朝周遭的妖兵们下令道：“行了，准备干活吧各位。”
content_en:
Chapter 265 Retirement Retirement!
"wave~"
Like a pebble falling into water, this dark golden elixir blended directly into Yunyang's body.
Immediately, a life force that was more surging than 36D filled his limbs and bones. Combined with the experience gained from the previous battle with the "Red Named Monster" - the Yasha clan, Yunyang directly broke through to the late Nascent Soul stage.
But Yunyang could feel that he had only used a little bit of this elixir, emmm... dandruff, ninety-nine point ninety-nine percent of the medicine's power was still hidden deep inside his body.
Alas~I am not a casual man, but...but it gives too much~
…
After seeing Yunyang fly out of the seal mouth unscathed, the first reaction of the Dragon Clan demons who had been guarding the seal was bewilderment.
Until Dragon King Ao Qing, who kept the seal open, sat down on the ground with a "pop".
He doesn't look like a peak Nascent Soul demon at all.
"Knot, is it over?"
These words seemed to be asking, but also seemed to be talking to myself.
"Yes, it's over."
Standing in front of him, Yunyang, who was wearing the attire of an inner disciple of the Xuantian Sect, still had the same fluttering look, with his hands behind his back as if he was an old man who had just returned from a walk.
The tone was calm, as if it wasn't a big deal.
Can't you speak calmly? Just after opening Wushuang, it's like entering sage mode.
"Oh, by the way, the Guan Yaksha clan is quite big, and this sealing formation is quite good. Anyway, my formation skills are far behind compared to it. Maybe you can make good use of it."
Yunyang did not forget to give suggestions.
"Thank you." Ao Qingchang let out a sigh of relief and stood up. He said slightly apologetically: "I'm sorry to make you laugh. I'm really excited to know that the mountain pressing on Dragon Palace is gone."
"Understood."
Yunyang nodded.
With this atmosphere already in place, we can’t just suddenly say “gu gu ga ga”, right?
"That... Lie'er." Ao Qing called the eldest prince of the Dragon Palace who was also confused, took out a dark token and pushed it into his arms, "Okay, from now on the Dragon Palace will be handed over to you."
"Huh? Huh?!"
Isn't this a bit too sudden?
"Leave it to you." Ao Qing was like, ah no, at this moment he was just a retired old man, hurriedly trying to hand over the work to his successor, "If it weren't for the hidden danger of Yasha weighing on my head, I would have stopped wanting to do it a long time ago. After I bury your brother, I will go find a way to cure your sister and solve these two problems. Whether I am a sitting corpse or I am lucky enough to be promoted to a god and go to a higher realm, I will not have any regrets."
"..." After hearing his father's confession, the eldest prince couldn't help but be silent for a moment, but he still hesitated a little, "But I am a golden elixir...my ability may not be enough..."
"Didn't you do a good job in usurping the throne before? Oh, I didn't mean to belittle you." Dragon King Ao Qing patted the eldest prince's shoulder, "Old shrimp and old crab are loyal and willing to follow you. When preparing for the war, they made decisive decisions and commanded well. In addition to their strength, You already have all the qualities to become a leader. Now that the mountain of Yasha has been removed, the strength requirements for the heir of the Dragon Palace are not so heavy. Slowly improve, and you will definitely be able to step into the Nascent Soul before I sit down or find an opportunity to be promoted to the God."
After saying that, Ao Qing did not give his eldest son any chance to refute or give in. He directly made a gesture of invitation to Yunyang and said: "I'm sorry to keep you waiting for a while. Please, your Excellency, I will take you to the treasure house of Dragon Palace to fulfill the previous promise."
Looking at his father who left immediately, the eldest prince looked at the dark token in his hand again. His hundreds of years of experience could not help but appear in his mind, and he laughed as if relieved.
Chapter 265 Retirement Retirement!
He shook his head and put away the jet black token.He stood up and ordered to the demon soldiers around him: "Okay, everyone, get ready to work."
